summary: PulseGuard v0.6.18 is a reliability and final-layout pass: automatic updates preflight locked files safely, UI artwork no longer holds package files open, pending Dashboard/Optimize spacing fixes are enforced, BIOS notifications use an explicit scan flag with full diagnostics, and Dashboard stability/status cards are reconciled with the underlying findings.

sections.heading: Updater lock failure prevented
sections.detail: PulseGuard now preflights every program file before changing the installation. If another PulseGuard window is holding a file open, the updater changes nothing and asks you to close the old window and Retry. Rollback is no longer entered for a lock discovered before installation.

sections.heading: UI artwork no longer locks release assets
sections.detail: All splash, logo and Optimize artwork is loaded from memory and cloned before display. The source PNG files are released immediately instead of remaining locked by System.Drawing.Image.FromFile.

sections.heading: Quick Actions fill the full card
sections.detail: All five Dashboard Quick Action buttons divide the entire available card height evenly, including leftover pixels. The previous 64-pixel height cap is removed, so the buttons grow substantially on a maximized Dashboard instead of leaving empty space below.

sections.heading: Optimize process/change split enforced
sections.detail: The responsive Optimize layout continues to use an exact 55% Optimization Process / 45% Changes Recorded split, with Changes Recorded consuming the exact remainder and no later resize handler overriding the bounds.

sections.heading: BIOS update prompt made deterministic
sections.detail: Vendor scan results now include an explicit BiosUpdateAvailable flag. Full Health Scan and automatic post-fix scan completion queue the BIOS notification from that flag, and the log records evaluation, queueing, display, or the exact reason a prompt was suppressed. BIOS flashing remains manual.

sections.heading: Driver header overlap removed
sections.detail: The Drivers-page status text now starts after INSTALL DRIVER UPDATES with a real margin, and drops to a second row on narrow windows instead of touching or overlapping the button.

sections.heading: Stability card reconciled with findings
sections.detail: The Dashboard Stability card now shows Monitoring when power/shutdown, BSOD, or application-stability history is still being monitored. Excellent is reserved for cases with no active or monitored stability finding; an available BIOS update remains a separate firmware/vendor-update state.

sections.heading: ASUS DriverHub remains browser-only
sections.detail: OPEN ASUS DRIVERHUB continues to open https://driverhub.asus.com/en rather than launching or downloading the local DriverHub installer. OPEN BOARD SUPPORT remains the exact motherboard-specific fallback.
